purpose: Pre-optimization baseline for runtime profiling experiments

production_model.selection: lowest predicted runtime among eligible algorithms

environment.dependency_manifest: No requirements.txt is present at repository root; production model implementation is dependency-free.

timing_methodology.warmups: One correctness-checked warm-up before repeated timing
timing_methodology.algorithm_timing: Repeated per-algorithm execution; report median and spread
timing_methodology.adaptive_timing: Repeated end-to-end selection plus execution; report median and spread
selection_components_already_measured: estimated selection overhead as median end-to-end minus median selected-algorithm runtime
timing_methodology.cache_caveat: The benchmark computes graph features before adaptive timing, warming cached heuristic scale; reported adaptive timings represent warmed graph state.
timing_methodology.correctness: Compare returned path costs against eligible algorithm results.
